notes: Bans the upstream NLTK PyPI package and import root (nltk), GitHub slug nltk/nltk, and Debian aliases python-nltk / python3-nltk; allows runner-provided infra (python3, pip, setuptools, pytest, pytest-mock, regex, defusedxml, click, joblib, tqdm) and optional extras (numpy, scikit-learn, scipy, matplotlib, pyparsing, twython, requests) and does not ban org-wide or data-only names (nltk-contrib, nltk-data).
